faq.title: Questions? Answers.
faq.subtitle: The questions people ask us most
faq.openSource.a: Yes, fully open source. The code lives on GitHub under AGPL-3.0 — issues and pull requests are welcome anytime.
faq.privacy.a: All of it stays on your own device. SQLite metadata, the LanceDB vector store, and Blob files are stored locally — back them up or browse them whenever you like.
faq.macosQuarantine.q: macOS says the app is "damaged". What now?
faq.macosQuarantine.a: Don't worry — the app isn't actually damaged. Run the command below in Terminal, replacing <App Path> with the app's location. Or skip the typing: drag the app icon into the Terminal window and the path fills in automatically:
faq.windowsPreview.q: How do I set up AI models?
faq.windowsPreview.a: Open Settings → API Configuration and add an API key from OpenAI, Anthropic, SiliconFlow, or another provider. SiliconFlow's Quick Setup is the easiest — one click and you're done.
policy.about.title: About DeepStudent
policy.about.description: An AI-native, local-first open-source learning system that seamlessly integrates intelligent chat, knowledge management, Anki card generation, and a versatile document reader.
policy.about.section1.title: Core Philosophy
policy.about.section1.body: Let AI run through your entire learning workflow, with no more interruptions from scattered tools.
policy.about.section1.point1: All your learning materials live in the VFS virtual file system—a single copy that AI can read and search at any time.
policy.about.section1.point2: Your data stays on your device, under your control, and is easy to audit and back up.
policy.about.section1.point3: In chat, AI uses the Skills toolset to directly search, read, and edit data across every sub-app.
policy.about.section2.title: Open source & community
policy.about.section2.body: DeepStudent is fully open source. Issues and PRs are welcome—let's make it better together.
policy.about.section2.point1: Development progress and every release record are open for anyone to see.
policy.about.section2.point2: Requests and feedback from the community genuinely shape where development goes next.
policy.about.section3.title: Contact
policy.about.section3.body: For collaboration or suggestions, email support@deepstudent.cn. We'll get back to you soon.
policy.about.footer: Thanks for helping us improve the way we learn. Last updated: Feb 4, 2026.
policy.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
policy.privacy.description: DeepStudent ("the Software" or "we") is a local AI-assisted learning tool developed by the DeepStudent Team. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect information. By installing, accessing, or using the Software, you confirm you have read, understood, and agreed to this Policy.
policy.privacy.section1.title: Information we collect
policy.privacy.section1.body: We only collect the following anonymous technical information when you visit our official website.
policy.privacy.section1.point1: Website visit data: collected via the 51.LA analytics SDK (LA_COLLECT), including page views, referrers, time on page, and click heatmaps; used to optimize website performance and improve content.
policy.privacy.section1.point2: Local software note: except for third-party API calls you choose to configure, the DeepStudent desktop app has no other network behavior; local debugging data stays on your device.
policy.privacy.section1.point3: Anonymization and de-identification: analytics data is not used to identify individuals and is never used for profiling or targeted marketing.
policy.privacy.section2.title: Information we do not collect
policy.privacy.section2.body: We commit that the Software does not collect, transmit, or process the following:
policy.privacy.section2.point1: API keys: any API key you configure for third-party model providers.
policy.privacy.section2.point2: Conversation content: all prompts, chats, and responses between you and model providers.
policy.privacy.section2.point3: User data: learning resources, Anki cards, knowledge base content, vector databases, custom settings, and local files.
policy.privacy.section2.point4: Personal identifiers: names, contact information, device identifiers, location, browsing behavior, etc.
policy.privacy.section2.point5: Derived data: any profiles or statistics built from analyzing your usage behavior.
policy.privacy.section3.title: Data storage & local-first
policy.privacy.section3.body: The Software follows a local-first architecture and processes/stores data on your device by default.
policy.privacy.section3.point1: All user data (including chat history, cards, knowledge bases, etc.) is stored only on your device.
policy.privacy.section3.point2: There is no account system—no sign-up, no login.
policy.privacy.section3.point3: You remain in full control of your data: you can view, export, or delete it locally at any time.
policy.privacy.section4.title: Third-party services & data flow
policy.privacy.section4.body: As a local client, the Software can call third-party model services via API keys you configure (e.g., SiliconFlow, OpenAI, Claude, Moonshot, Qwen, etc.).
policy.privacy.section4.point1: Responsibility boundary: inference is performed by the third-party provider and is governed by that provider’s privacy policy.
policy.privacy.section4.point2: Data transmission: communication between you and the provider is secured via TLS.
policy.privacy.section4.point3: Note: once conversation data is sent to a third-party model service, it is outside the Software’s control.
policy.privacy.section4.point4: Disclaimer: we are not responsible for risks or losses caused by third-party data practices (including retention, training use, or cross-border transfer).
policy.privacy.section5.title: Security measures
policy.privacy.section5.body: The local-first architecture itself reduces leakage risk, and we also take the following security measures:
policy.privacy.section5.point1: Open source / audit: core code is open source and can be reviewed by the community.
policy.privacy.section5.point2: No telemetry: we do not upload data; debugging data stays local.
policy.privacy.section5.point3: Least privilege: the Software requests only necessary system permissions (e.g., file access).
policy.privacy.section6.title: Minors
policy.privacy.section6.body: Our services are primarily intended for enterprises or organizations.
policy.privacy.section6.point1: Minors should use the Software with guardian consent and supervision.
policy.privacy.section7.title: Policy updates
policy.privacy.section7.body: This Policy will be updated alongside software releases; we recommend checking back from time to time.
policy.privacy.section7.point1: If the Policy changes materially, we will notify you appropriately.
policy.privacy.section8.title: Contact us
policy.privacy.section8.body: If you have any questions about this Policy or our privacy practices, contact us anytime:
policy.privacy.section8.point2: We will reply within 15 business days of receiving your feedback.
policy.privacy.footer: Thanks for choosing and trusting DeepStudent. Last updated: Feb 4, 2026.
policy.terms.title: Terms of Use
policy.terms.section1.title: Service
policy.terms.section1.body: We provide smart chat, learning resource management, knowledge retrieval, Anki card generation, Q-bank practice, essay grading, a translation workbench, knowledge mindmaps, and more; capabilities evolve with each release.
policy.terms.section1.point1: Features marked as in testing may be less stable, and their behavior may change after updates.
policy.terms.section2.title: Your responsibilities
policy.terms.section2.body: Please make sure you have the legal rights to any content you upload, and take care of your own device and data security.
policy.terms.section2.point1: Do not use DeepStudent to distribute illegal or infringing content; review AI-generated content yourself.
policy.terms.section3.title: Disclaimer
policy.terms.section3.body: We do our best to keep the service stable, but we are not liable for indirect losses from data loss or downtime caused by force majeure or third parties.
policy.terms.section3.point1: Remember to export backups of important data regularly.
policy.terms.footer: Using this service means you agree to these terms. Questions? Contact support@deepstudent.cn. Last updated: Feb 4, 2026.
